name: Melchizedek
title: King of Salem
summary: Melchizedek was king in Salem and priest of the Most High God. He met Abraham after his victory over the kings and blessed him, and Abraham gave him a tenth. He is an enigmatic figure with no mentioned genealogy, used in Hebrews as a type of Christ as eternal priest.

keyEvents.title: The Meeting with Abraham
keyEvents.description: Melchizedek came out with bread and wine and blessed Abraham after his victory.

keyEvents.title: Priest Forever
keyEvents.description: David prophesied that the Messiah would be a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.

keyEvents.title: Type of Christ
keyEvents.description: Hebrews explains how Melchizedek is a type of Christ's eternal priesthood.
